entities.summary: Devin Antoine Gray was an American professional basketball player. He played parts of three seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Sacramento Kings, San Antonio Spurs and Houston Rockets and played in Spain's first division. He played college basketball for the Clemson Tigers.
